notes.title: Community Update #8 - Caves and Underground Passage
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋

During the weekend, we had a pleasure of taking part in [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/NcrD8FxF7SA?si=Gc0XJl0XO1o5pIZ3]Future Games Show at gamescom latam[/url]  - a great indie games event focused on Latin America region. We presented Truckful's new gameplay based on the upcoming feature - mysterious underground passage connected by caves scattered around the countryside. Let's dive deeper into what lurks below the surface! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/beb0d6e5b4e983439471602d8c7c0aee59fcab96.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cave entrances[/h3]

As you will be exploring the countryside and fulfilling your delivery duties, you'll encounter [b]cave entrances[/b], often hidden around the sideroads and covered by branches. If entered, you will encounter [b]old ruins[/b], [b]puzzling structures[/b] and many [b]traversal challenges[/b] that will put your driving skills to the test. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/731185438c908ef2bfb2390ca0ff03098f542079.jpg[/img]

[h3]Underground passage[/h3]

Driving through underground can be quite challenging! Many obstacles will require upgrading the pickup truck with additional equipment such as the [b]boost[/b] (showcased in the trailer!). The world below the surface is captivating and packs many cool details such as [b]sun rays peaking through holes in the ground[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/9c595a4ba00505ab603edd27c79d9a0ebe3c3237.jpg[/img]

What's going on with these [b]glowing footprints[/b]? You will encounter much more baffling evidence of a supernatural presence that is only visible with the [b]UV light[/b] upgrade. Once installed, you'll be able to follow this mysterious trail..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/19b880138b6577a32a645ed7d48312f22275a416.jpg[/img]

[b][i]What is the true origin of these structures, what lurks underground?[/i][/b] You will need to discover the mystery yourself, however town & countryside inhabitants will give you many hints and offer a background of their own experiences and stories shared.

[h3]Trailer on YouTube [/h3]

Watch, comment and share with your friends! 👇

https://youtu.be/98K9I7NgwE4?feature=shared

notes.title: Community Update #7 - Theresa's garage, forest overgrowth and demo update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We're back with another community update, shining a light at new content we've been adding to Truckful. Buckle up and let's go!

[h3]Theresa's Garage[/h3]

Introduced in our recent community update, Theresa is a mechanic who owns a garage located on the outskirts of the town. She is very helpful and caring, always making sure your pickup truck works as intended, [b]offering upgrades, vehicle customisations and more[/b]. Meet Theresa! 👋👵

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/a390a140fb820bc87dccba4157bc4117d1f05bba.png[/img]

Here is a first look at the Garage aka Repair Shop - with a wide roundabout and just enough space to drive and park easily. Once parked, players will be able to [b]pack[/b], [b]customise[/b] and [b]upgrade[/b] the pickup truck with different [b]equipment, paint types, customised body[/b] and [b]additional ornaments[/b] like [b]stickers, hood figurines [/b]etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/86bcc0139084b27ba1b3696525d78222ed8fb5c7.png[/img]

See more gameplay on our YouTube channel 👇

https://youtu.be/dG8Ld1OcOyo

[h3]Forest overgrowth[/h3]

The Forest has many mysteries and we're excited to reveal another 'threat' that awaits you there. Apart from its original antagonists like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3090810/view/519702902706536505?l=english]The Ghost Truck[/url], players will encounter environmental adversities such as [b]forest overgrowth[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/9f5aa6edbf47c9047c25c50aa8fcca5b56af2d70.jpg[/img]

Once our pickup truck is powerful enough to explore the overgrowth it will be able to [b]climb the entangled branches[/b] that lead to [b]new locations, shortcuts[/b] and [b]places of supernatural origin[/b]. We'd *love* to share more details on its lore but also don't want to spoil all the exciting exploration that awaits players on the higher levels of these supernatural creations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/81877386a002be0de715eff99768262bcb970a8b.jpg[/img]
[i]'Its origin remains unknown and its roots go deep into the fabric of the forest. Nobody knows where the gigantic branches lead and it requires a very skilled explorer to unravel its mystery.'[/i]

[h3]Demo update[/h3]

First of all, we need to thank everyone expressing their interest in [b]Truckful's demo[/b] - we appreciate it greatly! Knowing how important a high quality demo is these days, we're making sure you get a polished first experience with our game. 

Right now, we're happy with demo's content and playtime, focusing on populating the world with more environment details, updated user interface and a bunch of quality-of-life features. [b]Current ETA is this year's early summer[/b] and we will make sure to let you know once ready!

notes.title: Community Update #5 - New Year in the top gear!
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

Happy New Year! We hope you celebrated Christmas and New Year's Eve with family and friends surrounded by truckloads of fun. We're back on the trail and start 2025 on the high gear on Truckful and in this community update, we're sharing some recent milestones and gameplay updates. Buckle up and let's go!

[h3]Ghost Truck[/h3]

We've been working on Truckful's first antagonist - the mysterious big, scary truck haunting the countryside during the night, affecting the small town residents who tremble with fear hearing all the stories. While roaming the countryside, [b]players will learn more about its origins and true nature[/b], eventually [b]having to face this steel monster[/b]. Here is the first look at its grim silhouette:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/86b899bd456b4b86feadf2b905b1dfbfcd1bc8bc.png[/img]

[i]" - [b]What hits you first is the smell. The smell of burning rusted metal and oil. Before you know it, you can't see anything... and then that noise! It's a horn, but it sounds more like a city siren, yet here, in the forest? I ran as fast as I could. Others mention corroding rust that poisons the crops and plants, leaving forest paths stinking of decay. Some drivers also go missing[/b]."[/i] - says Theresa, The Mechanic working in the nearby Workshop.
                                                                                        
[h3]Checkpoint Shrines [/h3]

We've been working on a [b]checkpoint system that would automatically save your progress[/b] during important game moments and came up with [b]charming shrines[/b] - ones that resemble small town roadside altars. For example - once you conquer a steep hill or any other demanding section fully loaded with cargo, you might want to [i]*phew*[/i] for a second, making sure the hardest part is done before finally delivering the cargo to the recipent.

We plan on having a variety of shrines scattered aroung the countryside with different night/day variations, below you can see an example 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/269da981b7bbf0aa680beea21689c05aafec5d4a.jpg[/img]

[h3]25 000 wishlists crossed![/h3]

Last but not least - we closed 2024 on a high note, reaching net [b]25 000 wishlists[/b] on Steam (now at +26k!) and would like to thank you - each and everyone! Your interest, feedback, gameplay ideas and overall support means the absolute world to us at MythicOwl and we continue working on Truckful more motivated than ever! 🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/a10f1b0a15ab8b33853a938af45ce2c014747d1f.jpg[/img]

We will be sharing more gameplay updates in the upcoming weeks. We're also working on a heavily requested demo but have no projected timeframe for public testing yet. Once ready, will surely let you - our Steam Community - know first! 

Feel free to follow our accounts on preferred platforms, join our discord for a chat and stay tuned!

notes.title: Community Update #4 - New truck design
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We hope you enjoyed [url=https://youtu.be/sS3hpCthbqg?si=LbOELd6JmzaRHYOa]Truckful's new gameplay trailer[/url] that premiered during last week's The MIX Fall Showcase 2024. This bit introduced the first character interaction (Meet Rotti!) and a brand new pickup truck design, that we want to explore further in this community update. 🚚

[h3]The 'OG' truck[/h3]
When Truckful was first introduced 4 months ago, we presented the very first design of the pickup, with a bit [b]rounder body[/b], [b]oldschool looking headlights[/b] and a front grill that resembled 1950-60s truck design. It was also described as [b]cozy[/b], [b]cartoon-like[/b] and sometimes giving the impression of a toy - we felt like there is room to improve, especially considering much darker atmosphere and future upgrade sets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/4c98f3ddaae753e83c75174eae849342429f8e3e.png[/img]

Overall, we're happy with the look, however when it comes to [b]sturdiness[/b] or [b]vehicle stability[/b] on more demanding paths while carrying heavy cargo, we wanted to improve on all of these fields, also making room for future upgrade opportunities that play a major role in Truckful.

[h3]New base truck[/h3]

So what's new? We completely [b]redesigned the front grill[/b], making it much bigger and heftier. We [b]added a manufacturer emblem[/b] that can be also upgraded/changed later in the game, giving players an opportunity to customize the look as they like - adding [b]stickers[/b], [b]hood ornaments[/b] and more. 

We also wanted to put more emphasis on your truck's [b]powerful engine[/b] that will also be upgradable, so players could experience easier and faster uphill deliveries, alongside a bunch of benefits. We played with [b]new wheel arches[/b] as well, already thinking about how future upgrades. Here you can check out one of the concept arts showcasing the heart of your trusty companion 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/9b3bdd7ad8ef1e14b642285384d67d49fc3e6173.png[/img]

We came up with a modernized look and [b]made the frame bigger[/b], so players would [b]feel more control[/b] while navigating through paths with lots of heavy cargo. This new design gives us more freedom while adding future upgrades such as tailgates, winches or even [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f_3q_EAOBA0&ab_channel=MythicOwl]recently showcased horns[/url]. 

So what do you think? Is it the '[i][b]old n busted[/b][/i]' or the '[i][b]new hotness[/b][/i]'? Let us know in the comments! 💬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/2f0d4871970a2252ceb59997d6a3edb5899bba8d.png[/img]

[h3]Vehicle frame upgrades & new truck ideas[/h3]

The most important thing - [b]this new look of your trusty pickup truck is the base design[/b] - meaning that it will replace the 'OG' truck and be the foundation for future frame upgrades, leveling up your truck similarly to how you upgrade the boat in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562430/DREDGE/]Dredge[/url]. 

As for new truck ideas - we're constantly working on new stuff and here are the 'baby steps' of another drivable 'Japanese-style' truck 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/cff488e3464510cd5acf718bfc863b4f5c2a720c.png[/img]

Like it? [b]Let us know what other types of trucks you'd like to see in Truckful[/b]!

notes.title: Community Update #3 - Bright path ahead!
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

October is in full swing now and we're back with Truckful's monthy community update, focusing on the newest gameplay additions to our upcoming pickup truck adventure. We were working on couple exciting features such as the horn upgrades. Let's dive deeper into these updates but first.. [b]a moment of appreciation of the work we achieved so far this year[/b] 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/0cb0e55b53b9d2a86cfd74991a5ddabd66bcb9f6.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved headlights in the dark - new gameplay[/h3]

Once the night falls, driving and navigating your truck can become really hard. We have just implemented the next iteration of front headlights, shining a better light at all the obstacles and road blocks ahead. Check it out! 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/c14d6a119d030b8e71941478dbde469e805b4774.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/KqPQhoAxxB8

In Truckful, you will encounter a variety of events that happen while delivering precious cargo and packages to the addressees. Some of the closed paths will require a pickup truck upgrade and the first example we're showcasing is [b]the horn[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/880c5a528c62cfa3d993a94844aefe608c6a4cb0.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/f_3q_EAOBA0?si=m8u8c-uSjHQ0-4ko

Installing the horn will allow you to [b]explore more paths and chase away flocks of animals[/b] - in our showcased scenario - its the sheep. Honk at them with [b]Tootey[/b] and watch them scatter slowly or upgrade to [b]Deafeator 2000[/b] for a fast solution that will be buzzing in their ears for a couple of days!

notes.title: Community Update #2 - Car lights, U-turns and puddles!
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

We're back with Truckful's new community update and to start of this announcement properly - we're very humbled and thankful for all the kind words and Truckful's reception and new ideas pouring into our pickup truck adventure. Last month was quite busy and we were cooking some exciting new game features, let's have a closer look! 

[h3]Car lights[/h3]
Your pickup truck, like any other car, is equiped with car lights. We've added the headlights and stop (break) lights that are both parts of the main upgrade system. You start off with low-energy headlights that barely lighten up the road ahead, to finally be able to aquire high-lumen lights that make driving at night easier. Here is the first look at the headlights 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/d3478e44c688ca39dc8f96d4fd98a798b91433e3.png[/img] 

[h3]U-turns and 3-Pointers[/h3]
Got a bad feeling about a chosen path? Saw something dark crossing the road ahead? You can turn around as long as the road allows you to - whether its a classic u-turn on a wide main road or a more demanding 3-point turn on a narrow forest path. We implemented turning and added new hovering cam that also changes direction to follow the car. Check it out in the latest FGS trailer below and the latest [url=https://x.com/MythicOwlGames/status/1825486005786259876]X post[/url] 👇

https://youtu.be/1vS4I6k5sWI?si=8-ABq81WrF4FUmJE

[h3]'Indie Ray Tracing' and the shiny puddles reflections[/h3]
We had Truckful's splashy puddles go viral on [url=https://x.com/MythicOwlGames/status/1833820255128289346]X[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/IndieGaming/comments/1fe7abr/brand_new_splashy_puddles_with_ripples_and/]Reddit[/url]! This week, we shared the effects of our new, custom technique called 'indie ray tracing', used to reflect the world and lighting in puddles and other reflective surfaces. We also added stylised ripple effects to puddles and splashes - please make sure to check out the video as it depicts the effect best! ([b]click the image below to get redirected![/b]) 👇

[url=https://x.com/MythicOwlGames/status/1834917391186174178][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/ad7748c9d18689e5e21635a889bf5ddef4ae1772.png[/img][/url]

💡 [b]Here is how it works[/b]: We are using a camera-from-under technique which mimics a planar reflection by positioning a second camera below the subject to capture an inverted view. Unlike screen space shadows it allows us to capture off-screen objects like clouds and the sky and compared to planar reflection techniques, it gives us more artistic control over the effect.

And this is the effect it has on players (shoutout to the great [url=https://www.thumbculture.co.uk/]Thumb Culture[/url]!) 😂❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/4645543e53dc27f238eac3e8f9e20ca9238673e3.png[/img]

[h3]When demo?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117219/a05adbc04ca8d7ce833c083bcf1428ef8b1fb912.jpg[/img]

We see you. We hear you. Since the day Truckful was revealed, we're constantly asked about the demo and really want to thank everyone for all these questions. We know you want to play it and right now we're working on it hard. Our goal is not to just make a demo for the sake of it, we really want you to enjoy all the gameplay elements and leave you wanting more. We should have more updates around December this year,[b] aiming for Feb/March 2025 [/b]with the public release.


[h3]Planes, Trains and Automobiles Steam Fest[/h3]
Steam's newest event focusing on different tools of transportation is now up and will be featured until September 23rd. Enjoy deals, demos and discover a bunch of exciting upcoming games focused on some great driveable and flyable machines! 

Check out the full event here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/plane_train_autos]https://store.steampowered.com/category/plane_train_autos[/url]
